NAME: R-4 Add no new asynchronous clock domain to the chip.
details: Add no new asynchronous clock domain to the chip.
implementation_note: Source: DEBUG [N-7.16], D-14

NAME: t_spis_rate
details: Oracle: correct at every half period from 49 ns down to 9 ns, none of them a pclk multiple. Caveat: ideal simulation edges cannot find the real limit, which is set by metastability and edge rates — the pclk/6 figure is an analysis result the sweep confirms, not one it derives
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_slave/tb_spis.sv, sweep checks [R-4] line 473 and [R-2] line 481 plus [N-7.1b] (the sweep prints its measured floor; the check itself asserts correctness at and above the 24 ns limit and the plan's 49 ns to 9 ns range is the sweep span) - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 Word-only APB never stalls.
details: Word-only APB, never stalls.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.12], [N-7.15]

implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_slave/tb_spis.sv, check [R-5] PREADY high in every cycle (line 636) - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04. See Docs/BUGS.md section 1h.

NAME: SPIS-4 TX byte shifted left
details: Every transmitted byte after the first went out shifted left by one bit (TXDATA 0xA5 answered A5 4A 4A).
implementation_note: FIXED. Covered by tb_spis [N-6.2] previous TXDATA re-sent on every byte (a5 a5 a5); PASS.

NAME: SPIS-5 enable inside a frame
details: Setting CTRL.EN while the master was already inside a frame started the shifter on the next bit and pushed misaligned bytes.
implementation_note: FIXED. Covered by tb_spis [N-7.3] re-enabled mid-packet and [N-9.3] checks (lines 590, 623); PASS.

NAME: SPIS-6 W1C against a new event
details: A write-1-to-clear in the cycle of a new event cleared STATUS while IRQSTAT kept it.
implementation_note: FIXED (set beats clear). Covered by tb_spis [N-7.3] and [N-7.5] W1C alignment checks (lines 542, 567); PASS.

NAME: SPIS-7 IP_LIMIT wrong
details: IP_LIMIT was 0x020 (copied from PWM) so offsets 0x10 to 0x1C swallowed writes instead of raising PSLVERR.
implementation_note: FIXED. Covered by tb_spis [R-5] every offset with no register answers PSLVERR (line 402); PASS.

NAME: INT-1 SPI slave missing from map
details: The system description lacked the SPI slave in apb.windows, peripheral_functions and dma.assignment, so the generated map had no base, window or DMA channel for it.
implementation_note: FIXED. Covered by t_chip_periph step 1 (ID read of block 14) and t_chip_integ step 5 DMA line; both chip tests PASS.

NAME: INT-3 SPI slave interrupt masked
details: clic_top default IE_MASK excluded IDs 13 and 14 so the SPI slave interrupt could not be enabled (CLICIE[14] read 0).
implementation_note: FIXED (mask generated from the ID map). Covered by t_chip_integ step 4 (steps 47-48, CLIC interrupt from SPI slave); PASS.
